description: x402 readiness check for any paid API URL: probes it without paying and reports whether it returns a valid 402, where the requirements are (header or body, v1 or v2), network, asset, price in USD, payTo (with EIP-55 checksum check), EIP-712 token domain, timeout, resource URL and Bazaar discovery. Returns ready or needs_fixes with a 0-100 score and a list of specific issues. Use before listing an endpoint or paying it. Never pays. Price $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"url":"https://api.example.com/v1/data","probe":{"method":"GET","status":402,"redirects":0,"ms":312},"x402_detected":true,"ready":true,"score":100,"verdict":"ready","version":2,"delivered_via":"PAYMENT-REQUIRED header","accepts":[{"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","asset_symbol":"USDC","amou

method.description: Optional. Default tries GET, then POST if GET returns 404 or 405

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the paid endpoint to probe

name: x402_endpoint_check
